head: codex/5345-v0918-wp10-thin-cli-selector
title: [v0.91.8][WP-10] Implement thin ADL CLI and authoritative selector
body:
Implements #5345. Adds the thin Rust ADL v2 CLI, records signing and verification adapters, atomic generation selector, verified rollback, and stable installer proof.

Validation: focused cargo tests, strict Clippy, preparation/implementation gates, and installer-selector integration lane.
